text: What I am looking for is not out there, it is in me.
author: Helen Keller

archive.text: Do not block the way of inquiry.
archive.author: Charles Sanders Peirce

archive.text: The state which belongs to one man is no state at all.
archive.author: Sophocles

archive.text: Our march to freedom is irreversible. We must not allow fear to stand in our way.
archive.author: Nelson Mandela

archive.text: I am proud to belong to a religion which has taught the world both tolerance and universal acceptance.
archive.author: Swami Vivekananda

archive.text: I, with a deeper instinct, choose a man who compels my strength, who makes enormous demands on me, who does not doubt my courage or my toughness, who does not believe me naïve or innocent, who has the courage to treat me like a woman.
archive.author: Anais Nin

archive.text: Let us be a little humble; let us think that the truth may not perhaps be entirely with us.
archive.author: Jawaharlal Nehru

archive.text: Where there is ruin, there is hope for a treasure.
archive.author: Rumi
